## Lavanda 1.1.0

This release adds a standalone installer for FreeBSD.

### FreeBSD

- Added `install-freebsd.sh`, a POSIX `sh` installer compatible with FreeBSD's `/bin/sh` and BSD `sed`. It is self-contained and does not call `build.sh` or `install.sh`.
- Installs per-user by default: `$XDG_DATA_HOME/themes`, else `~/.themes`, else `~/.local/share/themes`. Use `-d /usr/local/share/themes` for a system-wide install.
- Supports the same variant options as `install.sh`: `-t`, `-c`, `-s`, `-n`, `-i`, `-l` and `-u`.
- Detects `gnome-shell` and installs GNOME Shell styles only when it is present; otherwise the GTK, Metacity, XFWM4, Plank and Cinnamon parts are installed and the Shell part is skipped.
- Detects `sassc` and, when missing, tells the user to install it with `sudo pkg install sassc` instead of installing packages itself.
- GNOME Shell style branch selection matches `install.sh` (3.28 through 51).

### Documentation

- README: added FreeBSD installation instructions.

### Installation

On FreeBSD:

```sh
sudo pkg install sassc
./install-freebsd.sh
```

On other systems the existing `install.sh` workflow is unchanged.
